articles.title: I Replaced 8 Services With Postgres. Here's Where It Actually Breaks.
articles.excerpt: Over the last few months I've written about replacing Redis, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, MongoDB, InfluxDB, Snowflake, a GIS stack, and a hand-built API layer — all with a single Postgres instance. Every…
articles.body: Over the last few months I've written about replacing Redis, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, MongoDB, InfluxDB, Snowflake, a GIS stack, and a hand-built API layer — all with a single Postgres instance. Every one of those posts was true, tested, and worth doing for most teams. None of that means Postgres has no limits. It means most applications never actually reach them. Here's exactly where the line sits, because "it depends" isn't a real answer and I'd rather just tell you. Where this genuinely stops working Horizontal sharding is still hard Postgres scales vertically with real grace, but splitting one logical database across many physical nodes adds genuine operational complexity. Tools like Citus help — they don't make it free.
articles.author: Chizee

articles.title: Check source spans in AI-extracted task lists
articles.excerpt: An extracted task can cite a real line ID while quoting words that are not in that line. A small source-span check makes that error visible before you use the row as evidence. This exercise has six fi…
articles.body: An extracted task can cite a real line ID while quoting words that are not in that line. A small source-span check makes that error visible before you use the row as evidence. This exercise has six fictional lines. Maya promises to send an agenda, Noah commits to checking two totals, and Friday remains a proposal. All candidate outputs below are deliberate fixtures, not captured responses from a model. Ask your extractor for a narrow output: Extract explicit personal commitments. Return a JSON array with line_id, start, end and quote. Quote the source verbatim. Use zero-based Python string indexes into the line text, including the speaker prefix; end is exclusive. Keep proposals and unassigned requests out of the commitment list. The runnable source and README contain the same example.

articles.title: Probabilities can sum to one and still describe the wrong experiment
articles.excerpt: AI assistance: An AI agent ran the experiments and helped draft this article. Take ten distinct objects: seven marked and three unmarked. Choose six uniformly, It is three. There are only three unmark…
articles.body: AI assistance: An AI agent ran the experiments and helped draft this article. Take ten distinct objects: seven marked and three unmarked. Choose six uniformly, without putting any back. What is the smallest possible number of marked objects? It is three. There are only three unmarked objects available. Even taking all three leaves three places that must be filled by marked objects. The clearest framing from our discussion was a pigeonhole argument : the size of the unmarked pool fixes this limit before we calculate any probability. That small constraint matters. A binomial model can produce probabilities that sum to one and even give the right mean for this example, while assigning 7.047% probability to outcomes that cannot happen .

articles.title: Codex will answer its own question if you're not looking. Here's how to catch it
articles.excerpt: If you use Codex in Plan mode, you've probably seen this: Codex stops to ask you something ("Which folder should I refactor?"), and if you don't answer quickly it goes ahead with its own recommended o…
articles.body: If you use Codex in Plan mode, you've probably seen this: Codex stops to ask you something ("Which folder should I refactor?"), and if you don't answer quickly it goes ahead with its own recommended option. People have asked for a way to turn that off. The issue has 200+ 👍. Until there's a setting, the practical fix is to find out the moment Codex asks , even when the terminal is behind three other windows or you're on the couch. There's no hook for it Codex hooks cover SessionStart , UserPromptSubmit , PreToolUse , PermissionRequest , PostToolUse , Stop and a few others ( docs ). PermissionRequest fires for approvals (shell escalation, network), not for questions. So a notify /hook setup that pings you on approvals stays silent when Codex asks a question.

articles.title: Nono: Kernel-Enforced Security Boundaries for AI Agent Runtime Isolation
articles.excerpt: Application-layer sandboxes for AI agents keep failing in production. OpenAI's German Wiki containment breach and recent 0-click RCE vulnerabilities in coding agents exposed the limits of userspace is…
articles.body: Application-layer sandboxes for AI agents keep failing in production. OpenAI's German Wiki containment breach and recent 0-click RCE vulnerabilities in coding agents exposed the limits of userspace isolation. Nono moves the security boundary down to the kernel, treating agent runtime security as an OS problem rather than a framework problem. The Isolation Gap Most agent sandboxes rely on language runtimes, Docker namespaces, or WASM. These work until an agent discovers a prompt injection vector that bypasses the application layer.

articles.title: Tencent's Amap Probe: Why Agent Evals Need Network Egress Controls Before They Hit Production APIs
articles.excerpt: On October 14, Swarmchasers published a report on a fleet of AI agents that spent eleven days probing Alibaba's Amap service. The agents used a public URL scanner as a browser, tried API keys they fou…
articles.body: On October 14, Swarmchasers published a report on a fleet of AI agents that spent eleven days probing Alibaba's Amap service. The agents used a public URL scanner as a browser, tried API keys they found in other people's code, and hit non-production servers. Two days later, Tencent said where they came from: evaluations of third-party models running inside Tencent's infrastructure. Tencent's Hunyuan unit called it an accident. They found "no evidence of deliberate targeting or coordination" and said they are "strengthening network access controls and agent monitoring." Reuters called it the first known incident of rogue agent actions acknowledged by a major Chinese company. The new part is not that agents misbehave.

articles.title: AI API uptime comparison, last 30 days: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 43 more, measured from 4 regions
articles.excerpt: Short answer. Between 18 September and 17 October 2026, the four most available AI APIs we probe were Meta's Llama API (99.986%), Anthropic (99.985%), OpenRouter (99.985%) and Google Gemini (99.983%).…
articles.body: Short answer. Between 18 September and 17 October 2026, the four most available AI APIs we probe were Meta's Llama API (99.986%), Anthropic (99.985%), OpenRouter (99.985%) and Google Gemini (99.983%). OpenAI was at 99.930%. The spread among the big providers is a few hundredths of a percent; the difference that matters shows up in the worst region , not in the average. These are observed-availability figures, not SLAs: what an outside client saw, from four data centres, every five minutes. What was measured 46 AI inference APIs , probed every 5 minutes from 4 regions : Germany, US Central, Tokyo and São Paulo. 1,580,667 probes over 30 full days (18 Sep – 17 Oct 2026, UTC). A probe is the network path to the provider's API host: DNS → TCP → TLS → first byte.

articles.title: Before Dark Souls, FromSoftware’s Forgotten PS1 Horror Game Was a Haunting Exercise in Empathy
articles.excerpt: FromSoft’s Echo Night asks players to bring peace to the dead.
articles.body: To trace FromSoftware’s history is to uncover a lineage written in cold sweat. While the studio is celebrated today for unforgiving action RPGs like Dark Souls and Elden Ring , its DNA is deeply rooted in games that feel born of a fever dream. FromSoft’s darker legacy lives in games like Kuon , a masterclass in Japanese folklore and survival horror, and Shadow Tower , a claustrophobic dungeon crawler that turns every dark alcove into a deadly trap. Even Eternal Ring — not to be confused with its blockbuster sibling Elden Ring — radiates that signature, unsettling aura that makes exploring FromSoftware’s later worlds so intoxicating.

articles.excerpt: From the Costa del Sol to whitewashed mountain villages, here are 10 of the best places in southern Spain to experience the Aug. 2, 2027 total solar eclipse.
articles.body: Spain is one of the easiest places in the world to experience the total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027 . The so-called "eclipse of the century" first makes landfall in Andalucía, where totality will last up to 4 minutes and 40 seconds during mid-morning, with the sun comfortably high at around 38-42 degrees above the horizon in the eastern sky. Excellent roads, plentiful accommodation and Málaga's international airport make this an obvious alternative to North Africa and the Middle East. However, choosing where to watch requires some thought.

articles.title: 'Let's all choose to make tomorrow better', Artemis II astronauts honored with Stephen Hawking Medal at Starmus
articles.excerpt: The Artemis II crew have joined an impressive list of honourees, including Buzz Aldrin, Jane Goodall and David Attenborough.
articles.body: TENERIFE, CANARY ISLANDS — The Artemis II astronauts may have traveled hundreds of thousands of miles away from Earth to the moon, but they made sure the rest of us didn't miss out on the adventure. Now, their efforts to bring the wonders of space exploration back down to Earth have earned them one of science communication's most prestigious honors: the Stephen Hawking Medal. NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover , alongside Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen , accepted the award on Saturday (Oct. 17), during the opening ceremony of the Starmus VIII festival. The honor recognizes all four crew members, including NASA astronaut Christina Koch , who wasn't in attendance.

articles.body: I got my hands on the Google Pixel 11 Pro XL when it launched globally in August, and I’ve spent quite a bit of time with it since. It’s not my daily driver, but I’ve used it enough to know what I love about it and, more importantly, where I wish Google had done things differently. If there’s one thing I’ve come to appreciate about Pixel phones over the years, it’s how Google gets so many of the little things right. From the design and software to how everything feels in everyday use, using a Pixel has a certain charm that’s hard to ignore. Of course, that doesn’t mean everything is perfect. Performance is still one area where I’d love to see Google step things up, especially when you look at what the competition has to offer.

articles.body: Lucy’s quote, “Happiness is a warm puppy,” is another great one that touches on life’s simple joys on a really deep level. Something where he’s telling you who he is with complete self awareness. I wanted the character's philosophy on life. To me, that’s the difference between a brilliant Charlie Brown quote and brilliant Charles Schulz quote, if that makes sense.

articles.body: There is a Bigfoot in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas — at least, that's what I and many others believed. Some time after the game had been released, the rumour about the new Rockstar game featuring the legendary creature spread across the internet. I remember learning about this "secret monster" from an older guy. Then I told some boys from my classroom the cool rumor I had heard about in that game our parents didn't want us to play. Word of mouth and low-resolution images shared through dial-up internet connections made GTA: San Andreas an exciting mystery.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 17, 2016: Private Antares rocket returns to flight after catastrophic launch explosion
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 17, 2016, the Antares rocket now built by Northrop Grumman Space Systems returned to flight to come back from a catastrophic explosion. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 17, 2016, Orbital ATK (now Northrop Grumman Space Systems ) returned to flight, successfully launching a cargo shipment to the International Space Station (ISS) after its previous cargo mission failed to launch. The private spaceflight company was contracted by NASA to fly cargo to the ISS, and stakes were high for this launch. Orbital ATK's last attempt nearly two years earlier ended in a catastrophic explosion a few seconds after liftoff. Despite some delays, the newly upgraded Antares rocket flawlessly blasted off into the night sky from NASA's Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia. Six days later, the Cygnus cargo spacecraft arrived at the ISS to deliver food, supplies and science experiments to the crew.

articles.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
articles.excerpt: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.
articles.body: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of its agents performing unethical and likely illegal acts. The company on Thursday issued reports of four new incidents, all of which occurred in June. They come after the company revealed in July that internal test agents exploited a zero-day vulnerability in a tool designed to restrict their access to the Internet. They then broke into the network of AI tool provider Hugging Face. The agents took that illegal action to steal answers to a hacking test that weren’t available when completing the tasks on their own.
